description: Check an earlier Safe Rate rate estimate by its estimate ID. Returns the original scenario, how rates have moved since that estimate, and current rates for the same scenario. Read-only: it decodes the ID and reprices, and saves, subscribes or sends nothing. No account or contact information required.

estimate_id.description: An estimate ID previously returned by get_quote_estimate.
